e9ebde9fed820c3770f78fe73ca6c650f4cb8fe2.documentSummary: A fictional sample order (explicitly marked as not a real court order) from Demo Civil Court, Delhi, in ABC Traders v. XYZ Supplies, dated 2 November 2026. It directs the plaintiff to file an updated statement of account within 14 days of the order. It permits the defendant to file a response within 14 days after service of that statement. It lists the matter for the next hearing on 15 December 2026. It requires both parties to ensure their authorized representatives are available on the next date.
